say:1:1330426001:1.text: I can't with all these waiting orders, duh!
say:1:1330426001:1.source_cn: 我当然想休息，可我的身后的订单不同意！
say:1:1330426001:1.male: I can't with all these waiting orders, duh!

say:2:1330426002:1.text: Those dwarves have been busy with their inventions lately. I have no idea what they're working on, but they keep sending me orders non-stop!
say:2:1330426002:1.source_cn: 那些矮人最近在忙着搞发明，具体在发明什么我不懂，但是他...
